--- 

🎯 WHY THIS IS A NO-BRAINER INVESTMENT ($1,000+ VALUE)

🚀 CORE ENTERPRISE MODULES & FEATURES

🔑 1. Multi-User & Role-Based Security
* Admin, Cashier, and Clerk account types with restricted access policies.
* Database Encryption: Passwords hashed securely using PostgreSQL pgcrypto.

📊 2. Executive Business Dashboard
* Instant operational snapshots of Daily Sales, Total Revenue, Active Items, and Low-Stock Warnings.

📦 3. Inventory & Category Management
* Full product management (Add, Edit, Search, Stock Adjustments).
* Dedicated Stock-Entry Workflow and automated low-stock flags.

🛒 4. High-Speed POS Checkout Engine
* Built for high-volume counter operations. Dynamic line-item updates, quantity adjustments, and auto-calculated totals.

📄 5. Professional PDF Receipts & Reports
* Printable A4 Receipts & Invoices with print preview.
* Filter sales reports by Today, This Week, This Month, or This Year and export as PDF.

🌍 6. Multi-Currency Engine & Custom Branding
* Set custom Store/Business Name across receipts and reports.
* Add custom currencies (PKR, USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SAR, etc.) with custom symbols.

🌓 7. Sleek Dual Visual Themes
* Dark Mode & Light Mode: Toggle seamlessly between clean dark mode and bright UI mode.
